primary_sources.quantity: QNUMBERS electric charge and source-preserving particle code

equations.neutralino: N* M_N N^dagger = diag(signed real masses), eigenstate rows preserved
equations.chargino: U* M_C V^dagger = diag(masses), negative/positive charged bases retained
equations.partial_width_bookkeeping: Gamma_partial = BR_channel * supplied Gamma_total; never replace total by sum of listed channels
equations.electric_charge: QNUMBERS row1 = 3*Q/e; explicit standard MSSM PDG identities cannot be reassigned

cp_conventions.real-signed: Real N/U/V, apparent negative eigenvalues retained with the required SLHA field-phase convention
cp_conventions.complex-positive: Complex N/U/V, positive masses; omitted IM blocks use the explicit SLHA2 zero default

noninferences: MSSM pole masses/mixings are supplied or transported from the explicitly accepted released lowMSSM provider; widths require a separate actual source-bound return, with no CMSSM or NMSSM substitution
No cross section or detector efficiency from squared mixing entries
Provider mixing prescriptions and loop orders remain explicit source assertions
No default stable lifetime for missing DECAY
Integrated decay tables do not establish off-shell/resonant differential phase space
